The Balcony

Condominium in Naiyang
HomeNew ProjectsThe Balcony

Project overview

Nine residential buildings (4 to 5 storeys) on about 22,000 sqm beside Naiyang Beach, opposite Pine Tree Park and next to Salute Beach Club.

542 units with swimming pools, a kids park and more than 50 indoor and outdoor facilities. Construction was reported at about 42% in October 2026.

Facilities & amenities

  • Swimming pools
  • Kids' park
  • Steam room
  • Sauna
  • Fitness center
